scientific_assessment: V2 prospectively freezes the exact 30-row cohort, three checkpoint identities, fixed forward contract, three repeats, execution order, numeric threshold, raw evidence, isolation, runtime cap, and four-way outcome structure. The remaining defect is narrow but material: the proposed controllable-implementation-defect conclusion compares Batch1 with implicit position IDs against batched execution with explicit position IDs. Because batch size and position-ID construction change together, that comparison cannot uniquely attribute restored agreement to position-ID handling.
root_cause: The package lacks a matched Batch1 explicit-position reference. REFERENCE_B1_IMPLICIT_POSITION versus BATCHED_EXPLICIT_POSITION_CONTROL changes two factors simultaneously: batching and position-ID construction. A passing cross-mode comparison could therefore reflect cancellation or a reference-semantic shift rather than correction of a batch-dependent position-ID defect.
